About the job
The Senior Software Engineer will contribute to the technical development of
Aquatic Informatics' predictive analytics products. These solutions help
customers use intelligent water technologies to protect the environment and
human health. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and
business leaders to design, build, and operate predictive analytics products
that leverage AI and ML.

In this role, a typical day will look like:
Work on applications that detect sensor anomalies, digital twins that simulate
water treatment plants, and LLM-powered agents that synthesize water data.
Own features end to end: requirements, technical design, implementation, code
review, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
Build and operate cloud-native services on AWS and Azure that scale with demand.
Write clean and scalable frontend (Angular) and backend (C#) code.
Champion AI adoption and use AI to automate and accelerate software development
lifecycle processes while following AI governance best practices.
Drive continuous improvement in productivity, quality, and team health.
Manage and enhance development infrastructure, including build and test systems.
Improve testing frameworks and contribute to unit, integration, and end-to-end
(E2E) testing.

The essential requirements of the job include:
Five or more years designing, building, and operating large-scale,
data-intensive, cloud-native applications using microservices architectures on
AWS or Azure.
Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
Strong background in Microsoft development (.NET, C#, and related technologies).
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Genuine interest in using AI to accelerate software development.
Hands-on experience with agentic engineering and AI-assisted development workflows.

Preferred skills:
Expertise in database design and development using SQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.
Background in environmental science, time series data, IoT, or industrial
controls is an asset.
Exposure to data science or machine learning concepts.
Led and mentored junior developers.

Why Join Us?
Career coaching, a retirement savings plan, and a corporate wellbeing program.
Compensation may include sales or revenue-based metrics.
